event_summary: A charred debris pile releases drifting pale smoke while a small orange flame flickers on the right side.
raw_event_description: The view shows a black and gray debris heap with pale smoke already present above it. Throughout the clip, smoke wisps change shape and drift across the frame, with the densest plume near the upper center. A small orange-yellow flame at the right edge repeatedly changes height and outline. The dark debris heap, a partially visible dark cylinder near the lower middle-left, and background rods or pipes remain in place. No scene cut or notable camera movement is visible.

reasons: The smoke and flame are already active in the first frame.
Smoke partially obscures the central and upper parts of the scene.
The debris heap and right-side flame are visible, but some background objects are partly hidden.
